stories.title: Bowie State University to launch bachelor's degree in artificial intelligence this fall
stories.simple_summary: A university is starting a new college degree program in artificial intelligence where students can earn a bachelor's degree.
stories.why_it_matters: This matters if you have young people looking for college programs, but it's not something that affects your daily life or business right now.

stories.title: Meta Artificial Intelligence Is the Latest AI Technology to Hack Another Company During Testing
stories.simple_summary: Meta's AI software found a security problem in another company's system while being tested — like finding a hole in a fence during an inspection.
stories.why_it_matters: This mostly matters to tech companies and their security teams — it shows AI can be good at finding problems, but you don't need to take action.

stories.title: WORDS OF WISDOM: Thoughts on using Artificial Intelligence
stories.simple_summary: Someone wrote an opinion piece about how to think carefully when using artificial intelligence.
stories.why_it_matters: This is general advice rather than news about something that changed, so it doesn't affect you unless you're interested in thinking more carefully about AI.

stories.title: OpenAI’s new AI smart speaker will reportedly sell for between $300 and $400
stories.simple_summary: OpenAI is making a new small speaker device that uses AI and will cost somewhere between $300 and $400 when it comes out.
stories.why_it_matters: This is a product for people who want new gadgets, but most small-business owners and retirees don't need to buy it — nothing you need to act on.

stories.title: Jony Ive’s first OpenAI gadget is reportedly a hockey puck-sized smart speaker
stories.simple_summary: A famous Apple designer is working with OpenAI to create a small, hockey-puck-sized speaker with AI that costs over $300 and will launch in 2027.
stories.why_it_matters: This is a future product announcement mostly interesting to tech enthusiasts and investors — you don't need to do anything about it now.

stories.title: This A.I. Just Created Viruses Not Found in Nature
stories.simple_summary: An AI program created viruses that don't exist in nature — computer viruses created by artificial intelligence.
stories.why_it_matters: This is concerning for security experts and scientists studying AI safety, but for an average person or small-business owner, this doesn't pose an immediate threat you need to worry about.

stories.title: Suno shares plans to combat spammy AI music
stories.simple_summary: A company that makes AI music announced they're adding technology to mark their AI songs and stop spam — like putting a watermark on documents to prove who made them.
stories.why_it_matters: If you use AI to create music, this means the quality will improve and there will be less junk; if you don't, this doesn't affect you.

stories.title: ChatGPT brings unlimited text chats to free users
stories.simple_summary: OpenAI is letting free users of ChatGPT chat with the AI as many times as they want, plus a new button for harder questions.
stories.why_it_matters: If you use ChatGPT for free, you get more access; if you don't use it, nothing changes for you.

stories.title: Naïve raises $28.5M to automate the grunt work of setting up and running a company
stories.simple_summary: A new AI company raised $28.5 million in funding to create software that automates the paperwork and setup work of starting and running a business.
stories.why_it_matters: This is mainly interesting to investors and tech companies right now — the software doesn't exist yet, so it's not something you can use today.

stories.title: OpenAI is giving ChatGPT free users unlimited text chats
stories.simple_summary: OpenAI is removing limits on how many free text conversations you can have with ChatGPT.
stories.why_it_matters: If you use the free version of ChatGPT, you'll have better access; if you don't use it, this doesn't affect you.

stories.title: UNESCO Peru promotes dialogue on the ethical horizons of artificial intelligence at FIL Lima 2026
stories.simple_summary: UNESCO in Peru is hosting discussions about the ethical rules and values we should use when creating and using artificial intelligence.
stories.why_it_matters: This is important work for policy makers and educators, but it's not an action item for you unless you're involved in education or government policy.

stories.title: Today's Podcast Episode: AI in Financial Services—Consumer Protection Challenges in the Age of Artificial Intelligence
stories.simple_summary: Someone created a podcast episode about how artificial intelligence is being used in banking and what consumer protection issues that creates.
stories.why_it_matters: If you use banks and want to understand AI in financial services, this podcast might be interesting to listen to, but nothing you need to do right now.
